d52cd2d445ec2f7f345ec4007798f699.overview: Between two Thanksgivings, Hannah's husband falls in love with her sister Lee, while her hypochondriac ex-husband rekindles his relationship with her sister Holly.

d56a2c0150c5d96743b30a53d42cf9fa.overview: A drama about explorer John Smith and the clash between Native Americans and English settlers in the 17th century.
d56a2c0150c5d96743b30a53d42cf9fa.tagline: Once discovered, it was changed forever.

d5b6c5ec191b5f39536c592ea08117bd.overview: The intertwined lives of two women in 1970s France, set against the progress of the women's movement in which Agnes Varda was involved. Pomme and Suzanne meet when Pomme helps Suzanne obtain an abortion after a third pregnancy which she cannot afford. They lose contact but meet again ten years later. Pomme has become an unconventional singer, Suzanne a serious community worker - despite the contrast they remain friends and share in the various dramas of each others' lives, in the process affirming their different female identities.
d5b6c5ec191b5f39536c592ea08117bd.tagline: You are not born a woman… you become one.

d5c547a740e6d6150c3abbcd59be8493.overview: A novelist attends the trial of a woman accused of killing her 15-month-old daughter by abandoning her to the rising tide on a beach in northern France. But as the trial continues, her own family history, doubts, and fears about motherhood are steadily dislodged as the life story of the accused is gradually revealed.

d5cef541339b12c8c297a1fcf689e49a.overview: On the run and in search of help, two wounded gangsters find refuge in the secluded castle of a feeble man and his wife; however, under the point of a gun, nothing is what it seems.
d5cef541339b12c8c297a1fcf689e49a.tagline: Sometimes there’s nothing left to do but laugh!

d5e2828186f5e5724f0aca0fca6834c5.overview: Jerry Lundegaard is a small-town Minnesota car salesman deeply in debt and willing to do almost anything to get out. Police chief Marge Gunderson discovers a string of violent crimes as Jerry's schemes spiral out of control.
d5e2828186f5e5724f0aca0fca6834c5.tagline: A lot can happen in the middle of nowhere.

d5e5bea3b22f2a7f3aa53d07f9202eab.overview: The Hong Kong super-cop must stop a group of blackmailing bombers at the same time that the villains of the first Police Story are out for revenge.
d5e5bea3b22f2a7f3aa53d07f9202eab.tagline: Jackie Chan escalates his one-man war on crime.
